integrity: Attached human-readable proof and two local Python/NetworkX verification programs; output transcripts from those programs are included. No external independent review has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Relative to connected simple leafless bicyclic graphs; does not assert identification among all graphs or cover graphs with pendant trees, directed edges, multigraphs, or higher cyclomatic rank. Classification proved for all sizes; independently audited novelty and proof are not claimed.
title: Colour refinement on leafless bicyclic graphs: a complete doubleton classification
